headline: Cisco Q4 FY26 blowout: rev $17.3B (+18% Y/Y), non-GAAP EPS $1.22 (beat); Q4 hyperscaler AI orders $4B → FY26 AI orders $9.3B (4.5x FY25); FY27 rev guide $72.2-73.4B vs Street $69.1B; hyperscaler AI revenue to reach $7.5B in FY27 (from $4B FY26)
summary: Cisco crushed the print and raised the AI supercycle bar. Networking capex from hyperscalers is now visibly bracketed: $4B Q4 orders alone matched all of FY25 AI revenue. Sovereign/neocloud/enterprise added another $1.3B (150% Y/Y). Stock reaction split — up 2.5% initially but slipped 4% AH on margin guide of 65-66% GM (hardware-heavy mix drags below consensus). Read-through positive for ANET, AVGO, VRT, APH, CLS on the AI networking/hardware chain.

headline: Coherent (COHR) Q4 FY26: rev $2.05B (+34% Y/Y), non-GAAP EPS $1.74 beats $1.65; FY26 rev $7.12B (+22.5%); optical-connectivity AI datacenter story validated as industry shifts from copper to optical
summary: Coherent posted a clean beat on both lines with GAAP GM 38.5% / non-GAAP GM 40.2%. Management framed the copper-to-optical shift in AI datacenters as an accelerator, expanding manufacturing capacity to keep pace. Read-through positive for AI networking/interconnect names — reinforces Cisco's $9.3B AI hyperscaler order tape. Not a tracked ticker but a strong sentiment marker for the AI infra optical stack, supportive of ANET / AVGO / CSCO.

headline: Applied Materials (AMAT) reports Q3 FY26 today after close (4:30pm ET); Street: $9.0B rev (+23% Y/Y), $3.36 adj EPS (+35.5%); prior Q3 guide $8.95B ±$500M — AI/datacenter demand the swing factor
summary: AMAT prints tonight. Consensus $9.0B rev / $3.36 EPS; company's own Q3 guide midpoint aligns. Beat-and-raise is priced given the SMCI/CRWV/CSCO tape, so the bar is elevated. Key read-throughs: HBM/logic capex commentary for MU / SK Hynix / Samsung; China exposure color post-January BIS rule tweaks; leading-edge etch/deposition mix for LRCX/KLAC.

headline: Nvidia raises RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96GB workstation) list to $16,000 on 8/12 — +20.8% in two months, +87% vs $8,565 launch; pricing power at the enterprise edge continues as Blackwell inference/train demand outstrips supply
summary: Marketplace pricing on the 96GB workstation card jumped again. Jensen has been public about 'Blackwell sales off the charts, cloud GPUs sold out' — the sticker hikes confirm no near-term relief on the demand side. Positive for NVDA gross margin trajectory, and by extension the AI infra complex (CRWV, MSFT, META, GOOGL as buyers; SMCI, DELL, VRT as system builders).

headline: US PPI print + jobless claims + Fed speeches today after benign July CPI (3.4%/2.5%) yesterday; markets pricing ~35% odds of a September Fed hike, 2-yr yield 4.14% (-6 bps); Nasdaq futures firm into the open
summary: After yesterday's CPI cooled and Nasdaq rallied on SMCI+CRWV, today's macro data risk is PPI (8:30am ET) and initial claims. Higher-for-longer messaging from Fed dissenters still in the frame — three FOMC members preferred +25 bps at July. A hot PPI would clip the risk-on move; a soft print extends it. AI infra names remain the beta.

headline: Samsung Electronics unveils zHBM concept at FMS 2026 — vertically stacks HBM directly above AI accelerators, claims ~8x speed vs HBM5 and >10x density; also shows V10 BV-NAND 400+ layers, HBM4E (16Gbps/pin, 4.0 TB/s), HBM5
summary: Samsung is pushing an aggressive next-gen memory roadmap. zHBM/zNAND-O flip the standard side-by-side HBM+GPU layout to a vertically-integrated stack — a direct challenge to the HBM-alongside-package status quo Nvidia/AMD have built around. Reinforces the memory-as-scarcity narrative that lifted 005930.KS / 000660.KS earlier this week on the Temasek headlines. Constructive for MU as demand for advanced memory across all suppliers expands.

headline: CoreWeave (CRWV) closes +19.5% on 8/12 to ~$90-92 following Q2 print — rev +112% to $2.575B, backlog ~$104B, Truist upgrade to Buy; CEO calls quarter 'important inflection point' as operating leverage kicks in
summary: Follow-through day for CRWV after the Q2 blowout. Enterprise adoption broadening, unit economics finally moving as scale hits. Read-through positive across the neocloud/hyperscaler chain — validates the FY27 capex trajectory that CSCO's guide effectively confirmed. Watch for pin-action into today's session on any further sell-side pile-on.
